name: Single-Arm Bench Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a stable bench with one palm beside your hip and your knees bent.
Plant both feet, brace your trunk and slide your hips just beyond the edge while keeping your free hand on your lap.
Bend your working elbow straight back to lower your hips slowly toward the floor until your upper arm approaches parallel.
Press forcefully through your palm to extend your arm back to the start, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep your back close to the bench and avoid letting your working shoulder roll forward at the bottom.
Use your bent legs for balanced support so your elbow tracks cleanly backward.
